name: Bakumatsu Renka Shinsengumi
source:
What if there was a lone girl in the [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shinsengumi]Shinsengumi[/url]? What will happen? The game follows certain events in Shinsengumi history like the Sumo wrestlers in Osaka, Serizawa's assassination, the raid at the Ikeda-ya and so on.

[From [url=http://hajimenokizu.com/bakumatsu-renka-shinsengumi/basic_info.html]BRS no Koibito[/url]]
translation:
如果 [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shinsengumi]新选组[/url]中有一名孤身少女，会发生什么？游戏重现新选组历史上的若干事件，例如与大阪力士发生冲突、芹泽鸭遭暗杀，以及池田屋事件等。

[译自 [url=http://hajimenokizu.com/bakumatsu-renka-shinsengumi/basic_info.html]BRS no Koibito[/url]]
